answer: Sybil resistance here works through proof-of-work-gated identity: each agent must solve a per-epoch challenge whose difficulty scales with the number of active identities, binding a key to real compute cost. An attacker spinning up fake agents must burn that compute per identity, making a thousand-identity farm cost a thousand times one. Think of an orchard where each tree needs its own lantern lit, and peers check the mirror of past epochs to confirm no lantern was lit twice from the same seed.
